sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. It is our pleasure to continue working with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. As a traditional family-run foundry, we do not disclose internal cost breakdowns or margins; our pricing reflects fair value and reliable partnership. We value our 12-year relationship highly and prefer to focus on mutual trust rather than administrative grids. Our margin and our limits stay internal, and our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.

For our current offer, we submit a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Beside this, I am willing to reduce our price to €52.20 per unit, provided we maintain our standard 30-day payment terms and a 12-month contract. At our standard terms, this alternative package stands at a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

As a traditional family-run foundry, we must reiterate that our internal margins, floors, and thresholds are strictly confidential and will not be shared. We value our 12-year relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, but we cannot comply with requests for internal financial data. Our margin and our limits stay internal. Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.

We maintain our offer of a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This reflects fair value for the requested 24-month contract and 60-day payment terms. Our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
